text:
The Nifty 50 edged up 0.06% to 25,044.65, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.47% to 23,567, indicating a modest but market‑wide gain. Advances outpaced declines (314 vs 174) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 71.8, showing participation across stocks. The India VIX fell to 17.42, suggesting lower volatility after the rise.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers of about ₹7,212 crore today, offset by Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) selling roughly ₹7,172 crore, keeping overall flows near balanced. Leading sectors included Pharma, Private Bank and Capital Markets, while IT and Infrastructure showed weakness. Options data point to a Nifty “max‑pain” around 25,000 and a call wall at 26,000, with a put‑call ratio of 1.07, hinting modest bullish bias. Bank Nifty’s max‑pain sits at 57,700 and a call/put wall at 58,000.

Watch the 25,000‑25,500 Nifty range and the 59,165‑60,029 Bank Nifty range for support/resistance. Key levels are the Nifty pivot points (S1 24,894, P 24,989, R1 25,139) and the Bank Nifty pivot (S1 59,165, P 59,453, R1 60,029). Any breach could set the tone for the next session, especially if global inflation data or Fed commentary shifts sentiment.
